subject: Privileged access PT finding — remediation sprint plan & ETA
messages:
From: acme-logistics-security@acme.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test finding #4 - privileged container/service-account token exposure

Hi Mina,

Quick note from the SecureAudit team following our pen test last month — we're seeing a medium-high finding in the report around privileged access: several containers were able to mount service account tokens that allowed read access to project-level secrets. The report excerpt is attached (pt-findings-privileged-access-jan2027.pdf).

For SOC 2 evidence we need:
- Confirmation of the remediation steps taken (what changed in IAM / SA token usage).
- Evidence that keys/tokens were rotated or invalidated (logs or signed rotation notes).
- A short explanation of limiting network egress for those workloads (firewall rules / NACLs applied).
- ETA for when we'll have remediation evidence ready for review.

Can you propose a timeline and indicate what type of artifacts you'll provide? We have a compliance window the week of Jan 25.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
SecureAudit (eng@secureaudit.com)

Attachment: pt-findings-privileged-access-jan2027.pdf
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: acme-logistics-security@acme.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test finding #4 - privileged container/service-account token exposure

Hi Marta,

Thanks for the summary and the attached excerpt — appreciated. We're treating this as a priority. High-level plan below; details and artifacts will follow as we complete checks.

Scope / short plan:
- Immediate: rotate the affected service account keys and revoke older tokens (Karthik owner).
- Logging: capture session invalidation and token revocation events in our audit logs (Irene owner).
- Network hardening: add egress restrictions for the affected namespaces and document ACL changes (Laura owner).
- Evidence bundle: consolidated zip with rotation logs, policy diffs, and a signed remediation note.

Proposed ETA: initial evidence for review by Jan 18, final bundle by Jan 22 (to align with your Jan 25 window). If you need earlier artifacts, tell us which specific items are highest priority and we can prioritize delivery.

Attachments: sa-key-rotation-plan.md (internal playbook describing rotation steps).

I'll loop the eng owners here.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Action items — PT finding #4 (privileged access)

Team — forwarding Marta's request and our proposed plan. Please confirm ownership and ETA inline below. I've created SUP-3421 to track the work: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421.

Karthik: rotate SA keys for namespaces: logistics-prod, logistics-staging. Deliverables: key rotation record, a short test showing tokens no longer grant secret read, and the rotation plan doc (attached). ETA?

Irene: capture and export audit logs that show token revocations and session terminations; include the query you used and a timestamped log export. ETA?

Laura: apply egress ACLs to limit outbound to approved ranges and document policy diffs (before/after). Also assemble the evidence bundle and sign-off note for compliance. ETA?

Please reply with confirmed ETAs. We want artifacts by Jan 18 for an initial pass, final bundle by Jan 22.

Thanks — Mina

Mina — quick status update from infra.

Work completed:
- Rotated service account keys for logistics-prod and logistics-staging on Jan 15 at 02:00 UTC. Rotation runbook used: sa-key-rotation-plan.md (see attached).
- Deployed a token-revocation job that invalidates older tokens and adds a short TTL to new tokens during rollout.
- Ran smoke test: attempted read of secrets with an old token (sandbox) — access denied.

ETA for deliverables:
- Key rotation record and signed checklist: Jan 16 COB (attached as a small .md stub in the evidence bundle).
- Keystore snapshots and rotation logs: Jan 17 morning — I'll push to the shared evidence Drive folder and update the ticket.

Notes / questions:
- We flagged two pods that had mounted hostPath volumes; those were remediated by removing the hostPath and redeploying. Will include diff.
- Irene — please let me know which log formats you need for the token invalidation events.

Thanks — Karthik
Lead Platform Engineer
